claim: Under a fixed low-rank and update budget, preference adaptation exhibits capacity-dependent inertia; adapter-budget rescue distinguishes an optimization bottleneck from an intrinsic model-scaling effect.

smoke.description: One 25-step renderer and lineage smoke per model; no scientific inference.

core.description: Confirmatory fixed-rank capacity test with direction-specific shuffled controls.

data_exposure.description: At 4B, separate diversity from optimizer-update exposure using the nested 2.5k subset.

adapter_rescue.description: If the core trend replicates, test whether fourfold adapter capacity rescues larger-model adaptation.

preregistered_endpoints.primary_optimization: held-out per-residue DPO margin change from the matched reference policy
preregistered_endpoints.primary_biological: held-out full structural-gate yield on a frozen prompt and seed panel
preregistered_endpoints.analysis_unit: independent training seed, with prompts and candidates nested beneath seed and model
preregistered_endpoints.claim_boundary: Qwen lineage under the declared LoRA contract; cross-architecture results are descriptive only

stage_gate: No stage may execute until its launch-plan contract SHA is explicitly confirmed. Adapter rescue begins only if the core fixed-rank trend reproduces across seeds.
